title: ISW Cross-Correlation Predictions for Energy-Flow Cosmology with DESI DR1 Tracers
abstract: Computes ISW-galaxy cross-correlation C_ℓ^Tg for EFC using linear perturbation theory, introducing the cancellation metric C to quantify opposite-sign contributions from standard and transition kernels.

core_equations.growth_equation: D_xx + (2 + d ln H/dx) D_x - (3/2) Ω_m(a) μ(a) D = 0
core_equations.mu_parameterization: μ(a) = 1 + β S(a), S(a) = ½[1 + tanh((ln a - ln a_t)/σ_cos)]
core_equations.isw_kernel: K(a) ∝ d/d ln a [μ D/a] = K_μ + K_μ'

cancellation_trend.description: C increases monotonically with tracer overlap with z_t

kernel_decomposition.K_mu: Standard ISW term (potential decay in accelerating universe)
kernel_decomposition.K_mu_prime: EFC transition term (temporal variation of μ)
kernel_decomposition.signature: Opposite-sign contributions near z_t cause suppression

falsification_criteria.EFC_falsified_if: Tomographic bins overlapping z_t yield A_ISW = 1.0 ± 0.1 and C ≈ 0
falsification_criteria.LCDM_challenged_if: A_ISW ≪ 1 with high C at z_t
falsification_criteria.decisive_test: Tomographic C_ℓ^Tg in DESI spectroscopic bins overlapping z_t
